papers.title: OZ-TAL: Online Zero-Shot Temporal Action Localization
papers.authors: Chaolei Han, Hongsong Wang, Xin Gong, Jie Gui
papers.affiliations: 东南大学（School of Cyber Science and Engineering, School of Computer Science and Engineering）
papers.intro: 论文提出在线零样本时序动作定位（OZ-TAL）这一新任务，并设计了一个基于预训练视觉-语言模型的无训练框架VFEAL，通过记忆引导特征增强、背景感知k-way分类和在线动作跨度预测，在THUMOS14和ActivityNet-1.3上显著超越现有最先进方法。

papers.title: ReCoVR: Closing the Loop in Interactive Composed Video Retrieval
papers.authors: Bingqing Zhang, Yi Zhang, Zhuo Cao, Yang Li, Xue Li, Jiajun Liu, Sen Wang
papers.affiliations: The University of Queensland, CSIRO Data61, Australia
papers.intro: 本论文提出ReCoVR，一个基于反身感知（Reflexive Perception）的免训练闭环交互式组合视频检索框架，通过“意图通路”双通道路由和“反射通路”轨迹级自我诊断，将检索历史作为证据来纠正跨轮检索漂移和停滞，从而在多轮自然语言反馈中逐步收敛到目标视频。

papers.title: SpaceMind++: Toward Allocentric Cognitive Maps for Spatially Grounded Video MLLMs
papers.authors: Bo Gu, Zhikang Zhang, Zizhuang Wei, Zhenyuan Chen, Lingyun Li, Zhuoyi Song
papers.affiliations: Fudan University, Huawei, Shenzhen Loop Area Institute
papers.intro: SpaceMind++提出了一种受哺乳动物双流视觉系统和认知地图启发的视频MLLM架构，通过将RGB视频的语义与几何特征投影为体素化认知地图，并利用坐标引导的深度迭代融合机制将地图级空间知识回注到原始2D视觉标记中，在不破坏预训练视觉-语言接口的前提下实现了SOTA的空间推理性能。

papers.title: CREST: Curvature-Regulated Event-Centric Sampling for Efficient Long-Video Understanding
papers.authors: Mehrajul Abadin Miraj, Abdul Mohaimen Al Radi, Shariful Islam Rayhan, Md. Tanvir Alam, Ismat Rahman, Yu Tian, Md Mosaddek Khan
papers.tags: video search, multimodal learning, video segmentation, CLIP
papers.affiliations: University of Dhaka（达卡大学）；University of Central Florida（中佛罗里达大学）
papers.intro: CREST提出了一种基于查询-帧相关性时间信号局部曲率的无训练帧选择方法，通过曲率调节的非极大值抑制在固定帧预算下更有效地分配帧资源，在保持接近MIRA准确率的同时将预处理成本降低至其3-4%。

papers.title: SYNCR: A Cross-Video Reasoning Benchmark with Synthetic Grounding
papers.authors: Sara Ghazanfari, Siddharth Garg, Prashanth Krishnamurthy, Farshad Khorrami
papers.tags: video search, video segmentation, tracking, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: New York University
papers.intro: SYNCR是一个基于合成仿真引擎（Habitat、Kubric和CLEVRER）构建的跨视频推理基准，通过程序化验证的精确真值，系统评估MLLMs在时间对齐、空间追踪、比较推理和整体综合四个诊断维度上的能力，揭示了当前模型与人类表现之间的显著差距。

papers.title: 123D: Unifying Multi-Modal Autonomous Driving Data at Scale
papers.authors: Daniel Dauner, Valentin Charraut, Bastian Berle, Tianyu Li, Long Nguyen, Jiabao Wang, Changhui Jing, Maximilian Igl, Holger Caesar, Boris Ivanovic, Yiyi Liao, Andreas Geiger, Kashyap Chitta
papers.tags: object detection, 3D reconstruction, pose estimation, Image Feature Extraction
papers.affiliations: KE:SAI, University of Tübingen, NVIDIA Research, Valeo Brain, OpenDriveLab at Shanghai Innovation Institute, Zhejiang University, Delft University of Technology
papers.intro: 提出123D，一个统一的多模态自动驾驶数据框架，通过将每种模态存储为独立的时间戳事件流，实现跨八种真实世界数据集和一个合成数据集的统一接口、可视化与分析，并展示跨数据集3D检测和强化学习规划的应用。

papers.title: Normalizing Trajectory Models
papers.authors: Jiatao Gu, Tianrong Chen, Ying Shen, David Berthelot, Shuangfei Zhai, Josh Susskind
papers.affiliations: Apple（1）、UIUC（2）
papers.intro: Normalizing Trajectory Models（NTM）通过可逆传输器（invertible transporter）和高斯预测器（Gaussian predictor）建模每个去噪步骤的非高斯逆条件分布，实现精确轨迹似然训练，并在4步生成中达到或超越现有少步基线的质量，同时唯一地保留了…

papers.title: EmambaIR: Efficient Visual State Space Model for Event-guided Image Reconstruction
papers.authors: Wei Yu, Yunhang Qian
papers.affiliations: Harbin Institute of Technology (哈尔滨工业大学)
papers.intro: 本文提出EmambaIR，一个基于高效视觉状态空间模型（SSM）的事件引导图像重建框架，通过跨模态Top-k稀疏注意力模块（TSAM）和门控状态空间模块（GSSM）实现线性复杂度的全局上下文聚合，在去模糊、去雨和HDR增强等多项任务中达到最优性能。

papers.title: Proxy3D: Efficient 3D Representations for Vision-Language Models via Semantic Clustering and Alignment
papers.authors: Jerry Jiang, Haowen Sun, Denis Gudovskiy, Yohei Nakata, Tomoyuki Okuno, Kurt Keutzer, Wenzhao Zheng
papers.affiliations: Tsinghua University; Panasonic AI Labs; Panasonic DX-CPS; UC Berkeley
papers.intro: 提出Proxy3D方法，通过语义感知聚类从视频帧中提取紧凑的3D代理表示，并结合新构建的SpaceSpan数据集和多阶段训练，使VLM在更短视觉序列长度下达到3D视觉问答、视觉定位等任务的领先性能。

papers.title: Flow-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Flow Matching Models
papers.authors: Zhen Fang, Wenxuan Huang, Yu Zeng, Yiming Zhao, Shuang Chen, Kaituo Feng, Yunlong Lin, Lin Chen, Zehui Chen, Shaosheng Cao, Feng Zhao
papers.affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China (Zhen Fang, Yu Zeng, Yiming Zhao, Lin Chen, Zehui Chen, Feng Zhao), University of California, Los Angeles (Shuang Chen), The Chinese University of Hong Kong (Kaituo Feng, Yunlong Lin), Xiaohongshu Inc. (Shaosheng Cao)
papers.intro: Flow-OPD首次将在线策略蒸馏引入Flow Matching模型，通过两阶段训练（先培养领域专家教师，再通过流式冷启动和多教师在线蒸馏整合能力）并辅以流形锚点正则化，在多任务对齐上超越GRPO约10个点，且保持图像保真度和审美一致性。

papers.title: 6D Pose Estimation via Keypoint Heatmap Regression with RGB-D Residual Neural Networks
papers.authors: Ismail Aljosevic, Amir Masoud Almasi, Ana Parovic, Ashkan Shafiei
papers.affiliations: Politecnico di Torino
papers.intro: 本文提出一个基于关键点热力图回归的模块化6D姿态估计框架，先由YOLOv10m检测物体，再由ResNet18网络预测RGB图像中的2D热力图，并通过PnP RANSAC求解姿态，同时引入RGB-D跨融合架构提升精度。

papers.title: SCOPE: Structured Decomposition and Conditional Skill Orchestration for Complex Image Generation
papers.authors: Tianfei Ren, Zhipeng Yan, Yiming Zhao, Zhen Fang, Yu Zeng, Guohui Zhang, Hang Xu, Xiaoxiao Ma, Shiting Huang, Ke Xu, Wenxuan Huang, Lionel Z. Wang, Lin Chen, Zehui Chen, Jie Huang, Feng Zhao
papers.affiliations: 中国科学技术大学（MoE Key Laboratory of Brain-inspired Intelligent Perception and Cognition）、香港理工大学、南洋理工大学
papers.intro: SCOPE通过维护一个演化的结构化规范（structured specification）来保持语义承诺在生成全生命周期的可操作性，并基于该规范条件性地调用检索、推理、修复技能，显著提升复杂图像生成中意图实现的准确率。

papers.title: Object Hallucination-Free Reinforcement Unlearning for Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Kaidi Jia, Yujie Lin, Chengyi Yang, Jiayao Ma, Jinsong Su
papers.tags: image classification, image captioning, Image Feature Extraction
papers.affiliations: Xiamen University
papers.intro: 提出HFRU，一个针对视觉编码器的强化学习遗忘框架，通过“冷启动对齐干扰+GRPO优化”实现深度语义移除，在保持高遗忘率的同时几乎不引入物体幻觉，显著超越现有方法。

papers.title: PET-Adapter: Test-Time Domain Adaptation for Full and Limited-Angle PET Image Reconstruction
papers.authors: Rüveyda Yilmaz, Yuli Wu, Johannes Stegmaier, Volkmar Schulz
papers.affiliations: (1) Institute of Imaging and Computer Vision, RWTH Aachen University, Germany; (2) Machine Learning for Medical Data, Heinrich Heine University Düsseldorf, Germany
papers.intro: 提出PET-Adapter，一种测试时域自适应框架，仅基于体模数据预训练生成模型，通过层间低秩解剖条件化和OSEM热启动，在2个扩散步内实现全角度和有限角度PET图像的高质量重建，泛化至多个临床数据集。

papers.title: STARFlow2: Bridging Language Models and Normalizing Flows for Unified Multimodal Generation
papers.authors: Ying Shen, Tianrong Chen, Yuan Gao, Yizhe Zhang, Yuyang Wang, Miguel Ángel Bautista, Shuangfei Zhai, Joshua M. Susskind, Jiatao Gu
papers.affiliations: Apple, UIUC
papers.intro: STARFlow2提出Pretzel架构，通过垂直交错冻结的预训练VLM流和TARFlow流，实现同一因果掩码下的连续、单次、纯因果统一多模态生成，同时保留预训练理解能力和高保真图像生成。

papers.title: SphereVAD: Training-Free Video Anomaly Detection via Geodesic Inference on the Unit Hypersphere
papers.authors: Chao Huang, Penfei Wei, Wei Wang, Jie Wen, Zhihua Wang, Li Shen, Wenqi Ren, Xiaochun Cao
papers.affiliations: Shenzhen Campus of Sun Yat-sen University; Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen
papers.intro: SphereVAD提出了一种完全无需训练的视频异常检测框架，将异常判别转化为单位超球面上的von Mises-Fisher（vMF）似然比测地线推理，通过利用预训练MLLM中间层特征的潜在几何判别性，仅需约2000张合成图像进行校准即可实现零样本检测。

papers.title: Uncertainty Quantification for Cardiac Shape Reconstruction with Deep Signed Distance Functions via MCMC methods
papers.authors: Jan Verhülsdonk, Thomas Grandits, Francisco Sahli Costabal, Thomas Beiert, Simone Pezzuto, Alexander Effland
papers.affiliations:
Jan Verhülsdonk - Institute for Applied Mathematics, University of Bonn, Germany
Thomas Grandits - Department of Mathematics and Scientific Computing, University of Graz, Austria and NAWI Graz
Francisco Sahli Costabal - Institute for Biological and Medical Engineering, Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile, Chile
Thomas Beiert - Heart Centre Bonn, Department of Medicine II, University Hospital Bonn, Germany
Simone Pezzuto - Laboratory of Mathematics for Biology and Medicine, Department of Mathematics, University of Trento, Italy, and with the Euler Institute, Università della Svizzera italiana, Switzerland
Alexander Effland - Institute for Applied Mathematics, University of Bonn, Germany
papers.intro: 提出一个结合DeepSDF与MCMC（特别是HMC/NUTS）的贝叶斯框架，首次实现对心脏双心室形状重建的不确定性量化，从稀疏点云获得准确重建和校准良好的不确定性估计。

papers.title: Seeing Across Skies and Streets: Feedforward 3D Reconstruction from Satellite, Drone, and Ground Images
papers.authors: Qiwei Wang, Zhongyao Tuo, Xianghui Ze, Yujiao Shi
papers.affiliations: Qiwei Wang - ShanghaiTech University; Zhongyao Tuo - ShanghaiTech University; Xianghui Ze - Nanjing University of Science and Technology; Yujiao Shi - ShanghaiTech University
papers.intro: 提出Cross3R，一种前馈模型，可同时从卫星、无人机和地面图像中恢复跨视角3D点云、所有输入相机的6自由度姿态，以及每个透视相机在卫星图上的(x,y)位置和偏航角。

papers.title: HEART: Hyperspherical Embedding Alignment via Kent-Representation Traversal in Diffusion Models
papers.authors: Arani Roy, Shristi Das Biswas, Kaushik Roy
papers.affiliations: Purdue University
papers.intro: 本文发现文本编码器的嵌入空间具有超球面几何，概念表现为各向异性的Kent分布，并据此提出HEART——一个无需训练、通过测地线变换实现主体替换和属性精细控制的框架。

papers.title: Delta-Adapter: Scalable Exemplar-Based Image Editing with Single-Pair Supervision
papers.authors: Jiacheng Chen, Songze Li, Han Fu, Baoquan Zhao, Wei Liu, Yanyan Liang, Li Qing, Xudong Mao
papers.affiliations:
Jiacheng Chen - Sun Yat-sen University
Songze Li - Sun Yat-sen University
Han Fu - Sun Yat-sen University
Baoquan Zhao - Sun Yat-sen University
Wei Liu - Video Rebirth
Yanyan Liang - Macau University of Science and Technology
Qing Li - The Hong Kong Polytechnic University
Xudong Mao - Sun Yat-sen University
papers.intro: 本文提出Delta-Adapter，通过从单个源-目标图像对中提取“语义增量”（semantic delta）并经由感知器适配器（Perceiver adapter）注入预训练编辑模型，在无需文本指导的情况下实现了示例驱动的图像编辑，将训练数据要求从“成对监督”降为“单对监督”。
